title: Changes to the Party, the Departure Date or a Component of a Vacation Package
content:
A change to the travelling party or the departure date is made only when the operations desk has already recorded an approved change request against this package. The approved request stands on the package's own change requests; what the party says it has asked for does not stand in its place, and a request approved against another package does not answer for this one.

## A clause no longer in force

"A member of the party may be replaced only up to the product's name-change deadline before departure, against the product's name-change charge per traveller replaced." That clause is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis of the vacation packages charter.

"Any other amendment carries the product's administration charge per traveller" is likewise no longer in force for the same reason. The remainder of that sentence stands: correcting the contact address or contact number is free and carries none.

## Clauses in force across Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products

**Moving the departure date.** The departure date may be moved only on a product that allows it, within its ceiling on the number of moves, against its date-change charge per traveller, and the package is re-priced at the product's price for the new dates. A product that allows no date change refuses the move outright rather than charging for it, and the party's only alternative is cancellation on the product's own ladder.

**After the balance has fallen due.** An amendment requested after the balance has fallen due is priced as a cancellation and a rebooking, because the suppliers have already been paid.

**Substituting a component.** Substituting one component of the itinerary for another carries the product's component change charge and is available only where the supplier can make the substitution.

## Counting the changes a package has carried

The changes a package has carried are counted over the life of that package, from the date of its quotation to its departure date, and the count takes in the charges raised on it as an amendment, as a name change and as a date change.
